admitted.text: Her offer of a threesome reads as a disguise for her own desire for a woman, which she cannot yet admit.
admitted.detail_quote: She had made herself not a woman who hungered for another woman, which he could see was unsurvivable, but a girlfriend offering her man a gift

admitted.text: Randi seems frightened by tenderness that reaches beneath her polished social face.
admitted.detail_quote: He could have the face. The face was very good. The one he had found was going back behind it, and she was not coming out again.

admitted.text: Randi reads as socially masterful, able to make calculation look like warmth and engineered contact look accidental.
admitted.detail_quote: all of it folded down into three seconds of execution so clean it looked like nothing

admitted.text: Her lunchtime questions read as skilled steering, drawing Vee's intimate secrets out of her bit by bit.
admitted.detail_quote: So. What were you wearing while he looked at you?

admitted.detail_quote: You've got her all weekend, every weekend, and you're in no hurry, and I can't think why you would be.

admitted.text: For a moment her own wanting seems to break through, quieter and more real than her usual performance.
admitted.detail_quote: It came a beat late and low, the first thing she had said all day at Vee's own volume

admitted.text: Her public claiming of Vee reads as warm, and also as a deliberate spending of social status.
admitted.detail_quote: Randi had just spent something on her, in front of the girls who decided what it was worth.

admitted.text: He reads as patient and focused on consent, always handing the choice back to the woman.

admitted.text: Under the care there seems to be a real hunger for a woman's raw surrender.
admitted.detail_quote: She chooses it, Randi. Every step of it. Or it isn't anything.

admitted.text: He seems to treat recruiting Vee as a thrilling game, which gives his tenderness a troubling side.
admitted.detail_quote: He had no name for the game yet, only the live private charge of something he imagined they could make together.

admitted.text: He reads as a generous, modest craftsman who makes things instead of showing off.
admitted.detail_quote: Patience. Paying attention. He said it like those were the whole secret.

admitted.text: For all his attentiveness, he seems blind to Randi's pain.
admitted.detail_quote: He did not know what he had done. He looked for it, back through the evening from the gravel forward, and it was not there.

admitted.text: He seems to carry a quiet, formative guilt over a past woman named Daphne, which now governs his strict refusal to push past closed emotional doors.
admitted.detail_quote: Daphne had built a door, once, and he had not respected it.

admitted.text: She seems to long to be chosen by someone who sits above her socially.
admitted.detail_quote: that she had been chosen, plainly, for reasons she didn't need to understand, by exactly the person she'd have chosen to be chosen by.

admitted.text: Her appetite, so long policed by her mother's voice, seems to be coming loose.
admitted.detail_quote: She bit her lower lip, knowing the cup would drip, and then found she didn't care.

admitted.text: Her shame and her desire seem wired together, so that the mother's verdict itself turns her on.
admitted.detail_quote: she could not find the seam between the heat and the shame because there was no seam, they ran on the same wire

admitted.text: Being admired seems to turn her from cringing into someone discovering her own power.
admitted.detail_quote: she stopped being the nervous girl bracing on the platform and became someone who'd just found out she had a kind of power she'd never been issued.

admitted.text: She seems ready to go into debt to stay at Randi's level.
admitted.detail_quote: The number was the most she had ever once handed across a counter for anything that wasn't tuition or rent.

admitted.text: Vee seems unaware that the two relationships she experiences as miraculous are being coordinated around her.
admitted.detail_quote: Both her friends turned toward her and not the professor, over a dress.

admitted.text: Vee reads as genuinely gifted and intellectually hungry, not merely dazzled by the glamorous people courting her.
admitted.detail_quote: taking a real situation and finding a structure in it. That's what I like.

admitted.text: She reads as fiercely loyal and quietly protective of Vee.

admitted.detail_quote: because the friend was the only part of any of it Cassie had ever been able to see.

admitted.detail_quote: The matching was very fast. She had not had time to choose the pitch.

admitted.text: She reads as steady and unhurried, a calm influence.
admitted.detail_quote: Meg was the calm one, dark-haired and level, a girl who ate like she had all night and let a sentence finish before she picked it up.

admitted.text: She reads as a bright, restless, eager friend who cheers Vee on.

admitted.text: He reads as a decent, harmless boy Vee has outgrown.
admitted.detail_quote: And I said let's be friends, and now we're friends, and he waves.

admitted.text: She seems motherly toward Pace, perhaps more family to him than his own.
admitted.detail_quote: Christine fed me twice what I ordered and wouldn't put it on the bill.

admitted.text: The bench: a patient apparatus of exposure that waits for its next subject, Vee.
admitted.detail_quote: full of what it was, doing what it would continue to do, waiting for the next time.

admitted.text: The thin apple slices: an appetite rationed and allowed out only in small pieces.
admitted.detail_quote: a girl who had been portioning herself, weighing every want before she let herself have it

admitted.text: The deadbolt and lock: Randi shutting herself back in.
admitted.detail_quote: the small click of the lock turning over, which was not a thing she had ever done before in his house.

admitted.text: The cap pressed under the thumbnail: Randi's private self-punishment, repeated whenever she is pained.
admitted.detail_quote: set the sharp inner edge of the cap under her thumbnail and pressed — slow and steady, down into the nail bed, where it would hurt.

admitted.text: The pointing game: shopping for a woman, framed as giving Randi the power to choose.
admitted.detail_quote: I point. You pick.

admitted.text: the burning maple: desire arriving as conspicuous change before the surrounding world has admitted the season
admitted.detail_quote: a single tree burning orange in a field of things that had not yet decided to change.

admitted.text: latent variables: the unseen motives beneath Randi’s friendship and Vee’s attraction
admitted.detail_quote: the word sat there in her notebook, underlined once, going nowhere

admitted.text: the right-angle substitution: separate desires becoming newly legible when Pace brings them into relation
admitted.detail_quote: Put them together, at right angles, and they turn into a single thing that's suddenly plain

admitted.text: The pool underwater: the one place where Vee's body is not looked at or wanted.
admitted.detail_quote: Nobody up there could see her. Nobody down here wanted anything.

admitted.text: The cherry pits: Pace's code of leaving no trace, which may echo how hidden his own game is.
admitted.detail_quote: We take nothing and leave nothing

admitted.text: the riser: exposure transformed from humiliation into elevation and chosen visibility
admitted.detail_quote: The apologetic stoop she'd been holding since she stepped up came undone.

admitted.text: Randi's white-gold band: one fixed commitment under her ever-changing surface.
admitted.detail_quote: white gold, plain and heavy, no stone, nothing to it but the weight

admitted.text: The flannel shirt: a stand-in for Pace that Vee clings to until she reaches the real thing.
admitted.detail_quote: the actual thing behind the proxy she'd been studying in her own bed since the hike.

admitted.text: The folded green panties: Vee's shame turned into a gift she gives on purpose.
admitted.detail_quote: She kissed him, briefly, and held the folded panties out toward him.

admitted.text: The uneaten stew with one line drawn through it: Randi refusing to be fed, her hurt left unsaid.
admitted.detail_quote: the sauce gone to a skin over the peas and the carrot, the one line she had drawn through it still there.

admitted.text: the dress: Pace’s attention made wearable, shaping Vee toward a version of herself that welcomes the room’s gaze
admitted.detail_quote: This one had been cut to the actual shape of her, and to no one else's.

admitted.text: Simpson's paradox: the same facts reversing depending on how the pairings are grouped.
admitted.detail_quote: Same numbers. Nobody touched one of them.
